$comment: Render plan for Tools-page card previews. These previews have been rendered and ship in public/tool-previews/. To re-render one, run it on a free GPU host, drop the encoded files in public/tool-previews/ as <file>.webp / .webm / .mp4, then run node scripts/gen-tool-previews-manifest.mjs and commit the files with src/lib/tools/toolPreviews.json. Every input is an original character or object generated by Adrift itself on the Create page: no real people, no third-party characters, brands or logos.

output.naming: hub card key with ':' spelled '--' (action:relight -> action--relight)

still.note: Every video preview also ships a still: it is the poster and the reduced-motion fallback.

formats: mp4 (H.264 main, crf 26, faststart, no audio)
video.seconds: 3-5, seamless loop (crossfade the last 8 frames into the first when the clip does not loop)

posts.wipe: Before/after: input on the left, result on the right, the divider sweeps left-right-left over 4 s (ffmpeg overlay + crop driven by t).
posts.cycle: Hold each listed result 1.2 s with a 0.3 s crossfade, then loop.
posts.clip: Trim the result clip to the listed window, scale/crop to 16:10.
posts.turntable: Record the GLB viewer orbiting 360 degrees in 4 s on a neutral grey backdrop.
posts.explode: Stack the transparent layers back to front, then ease them apart vertically and back over 4 s.
posts.still: Center-crop the result to 16:10; no video.

mara.role: Mara, the courier: original human character, the face of most person tools.
mara.look: Young courier, shaved undercut, yellow rain shell, messenger bag, calm determined expression.
mara.prompt: a young courier with a shaved undercut and a yellow rain shell, standing on a wet rooftop at dusk, neon reflections, 35mm photo --ar 3:4
mara.pick: Face clearly visible, both shoulders in frame, no text or signage in the background.

pip.role: Pip, the ceramic fox: original object/character for 3D, layers and product-style tools.
pip.look: Small glazed ceramic fox figurine, teal glaze with gold flecks, sitting upright.
pip.prompt: a small glazed ceramic fox figurine, teal glaze with gold flecks, on a wooden desk, soft window light, product photo --ar 1:1
pip.pick: Whole figurine in frame with some margin, clean silhouette.

lumen.role: Lumen, the tea tin: fictional product for the ad tools; the brand exists only in Adrift demos.
lumen.look: Matte cylindrical tea tin with an abstract orange sun shape, no text.
lumen.prompt: a matte cylindrical tea tin with an abstract orange sun shape, no text, on a marble counter, studio light --ar 4:5
lumen.pick: No legible text anywhere on the tin or background.

night_market.prompt: a rainy night market street with paper lanterns and steam, a parked bicycle on the left, wide shot, cinematic --ar 16:9
night_market.pick: No legible signage; the bicycle is clearly separate from the stalls.

rooftop_day.prompt: the same young courier with a shaved undercut and a yellow rain shell walking along a city rooftop at midday, clear sky, 35mm photo --ar 16:9
rooftop_day.pick: Mara's look matches the hero still; bright even daylight.

rooftop_day_clip.text: she walks toward the camera, slow tracking shot

mara_line.text: Package for the rooftop garden. Sign here... or don't, I'm already late.
